name: nextafter_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::nextafter_(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor other) -> Tensor(a!). Replaces each element of self with the next representable value toward other and returns the same Tensor object and storage. Tests cover supported floating dtypes, broadcasting, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, signed zero, infinities, NaN propagation, mutation, identity, and invalid shape expansion.
